name: Inbound Webhook Kit
summary: Per-provider signature verification, raw archive, dedupe, and replay for Stripe, GitHub, Shopify, Slack, and Clerk.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: WEBHOOK_SECRET_STRIPE
env.description: Stripe signing secret (whsec_...). Required only if you receive Stripe webhooks.

env.name: WEBHOOK_SECRET_GITHUB
env.description: GitHub webhook secret. Required only for GitHub.

env.name: WEBHOOK_SECRET_SHOPIFY
env.description: Shopify API secret. Required only for Shopify.

env.name: WEBHOOK_SECRET_SLACK
env.description: Slack signing secret. Required only for Slack.

env.name: WEBHOOK_SECRET_CLERK
env.description: Clerk/Svix signing secret (whsec_...). Required only for Clerk.

env.name: WEBHOOK_SECRET_GENERIC
env.description: Shared secret for the generic HMAC verifier.

env.name: WEBHOOK_TOLERANCE_SECONDS
env.description: Reject requests whose signed timestamp is outside this window. This is replay protection; widen it only after ruling out clock skew.

env.name: WEBHOOK_MAX_BODY_BYTES
env.description: Largest body accepted. The endpoint is public, so an unbounded read is a denial-of-service vector.

env.name: WEBHOOK_DEDUPE_WINDOW_MINUTES
env.description: Window for body-hash dedupe, used for providers that send no event id.

env.name: WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_PREFIX
env.description: Prefix stripped from the generic signature header, e.g. "sha256=".
